tasks.label: Configure Continue AI
tasks.command:
mkdir -p ~/.continue && cat << 'EOF' > ~/.continue/config.yaml
name: Dev Spaces vLLM Setup
version: 1.0.0
schema: v1
models:
  - name: In-Cluster vLLM Coder
    provider: openai
    model: "/models/granite-3b-code-instruct/"
    apiBase: http://vllm-service.vllm-cpu.svc.cluster.local:8000/v1
    roles: [chat, edit, apply]
    contextLength: 2048
    defaultCompletionOptions:
      maxTokens: 1024
  - name: In-Cluster vLLM Autocomplete
    provider: openai
    model: "/models/granite-3b-code-instruct/"
    apiBase: http://vllm-service.vllm-cpu.svc.cluster.local:8000/v1
    roles: [autocomplete]
    contextLength: 2048
    defaultCompletionOptions:
      maxTokens: 512
EOF
